app_set_data_desc: Statements in, CSV or JSON out
app_set_unlock_desc: Asks when you open Kosha. Your phone's PIN works too.
app_set_unlock_kw: app lock biometric fingerprint face pin
app_set_unlock_unavailable: Set up a screen lock on this phone first.
app_set_opens_web: These open {host} and bring you back.
app_set_hide_desc: Blur money until you touch and hold it. The account menu has this switch too.
app_set_account_colours_desc: A small colour mark for each account. Off looks like the web.
app_set_currencies_note: Hold and drag to reorder. The one on top is your default, so net worth and totals add up in it. The currency switch at the top of Overview steps through them in this order.
app_set_ai_intro: Optional. Kosha works fully without it.
app_set_ai_add_provider_desc: OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or your own endpoint
app_set_ai_key_stored: Stored encrypted on the server. Kosha never shows it again.
app_set_ai_privacy_intro: Fields Kosha may send to your AI provider. Everything else stays in Kosha.
app_set_export_note: Downloads open the share sheet, so you can save them to Files or send them on.
app_set_delete_intro: These can't be undone. Export first if unsure.
app_set_delete_account_note: Opens {host}, where you confirm with your email and password in three steps.
app_wel_import_later: Not now? You can import them any time from Accounts or Settings › Import & export.
app_wel_formats: CSV, OFX or QFX files from your online banking, or PDF statements.
